name: UX Design for Contemporary Technologies
description: Introduction to user experience principles and practices. Introduction to technological evolution and its impact on design practices. Study of contemporary and future technologies. Utility, usability and UX lenses of contemporary technologies. Introduction to the process of UX design. Design processes of utilitarian and experiential products. Everyday objects, their utility and their experiences. Introduction to human-centred design principles, research methodologies, prototyping tools and UX evaluation methods. Prototyping and testing of screen-based technologies. Prototyping and testing of immersive technologies. Industry standards, design systems and atomic design principles for usability and UX.
